judgement.impact: The user cannot know the card number is flagged as invalid and cannot correct it to complete payment.
The user hears "Total:" with no amount and cannot confirm the final charge before paying.
The screen-reader user hears only generic image and cannot know about the 50% OFF TODAY promotion seen by sighted users.
Blind user hears Close instead of delete/trash and cannot know the button performs a delete action, risking unintended loss or avoiding the control.
The user hears only Submit and cannot tell from the button itself that activating it will pay R1,249.
Blind user hears only 'Click here' and cannot know the link leads to the Terms they agree to by paying.
Screen-reader user still encounters a generic help control immediately after the CVV field, matching the visual '?' cue and retaining the same ability to get CVV help.
The user hears only "Button" and cannot know this control pays with wallet or choose it confidently among payment options.
